title: Multi-Location Interior Contractors: Align Salesforce Project Sites With Acumatica Billing Contacts
summary: Keep interior-installation sites, general-contractor contacts and billing recipients distinct across Salesforce and Acumatica.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Interior contractors should separate the installation site, general contractor, property owner and billing recipient when connecting Salesforce with Acumatica. Use stable project and site identifiers, then map each contact's role and effective dates. Sales can maintain relationship context while project administration controls site coordination and finance owns bill-to instructions. A site superintendent changing should not redirect invoices, and a new billing contact should not remove access instructions for the installation crew.


Explore the complete[commercial flooring and interior installation integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/commercial-flooring-interiors) for the systems and processes around this guide.
